Jen: FYI — Lynx support flagged a p99 latency spike hitting customers on model-gamma in us-east-1. Spike started ~2026-03-16T07:30Z. p50 looks normal, p99 ~2-3x. Opening thread for async triage :eyes:
Marco: Can you paste a sample request id + trace? Any recent deploys to that region?
Jen: sample request id: req_0x9b7f3a. Top-level trace shows long wait in kernel-selector + streaming stalls. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T07:30:12Z] request=req_0x9b7f3a serve_time_ms=1243 stage=kernel-selector fallback=quantized-v2
[2026-03-16T07:30:12Z] request=req_0x9b7f3a backend_write_ms=940 stage=kv-cache miss
```
Marco: deploy-bot, any rollouts around 07:25Z?
deploy-bot: Deployment: model-gamma/v1.3 rolled out to us-east-1 at 2026-03-16T07:25:10Z (canary -> 100%).
Ravi: I can run a quick micro-bench against us-east nodes for model-gamma. Which QPS and prompt length to use?
Jen: Use 20 qps, typical prompt ~300 tokens, 2048 max. Repro happened with many short bursts from Lynx so also run burst pattern (200 qps for 10s / 10s idle).
Carla: Reproduced locally against canary image. Quick bench (cmd + output):
```
$ bench run --model model-gamma --qps 20 --prompt-len 300 --region us-east-1
p50=85ms p95=210ms p99=1340ms 
(same bench with burst pattern => p99 spikes to 2s+)
```
Lisa: I'm pulling KV cache hitrate for the affected nodes now. If it's missing a lot, that'd explain backend stalls.
Lisa: KV hitrate for node set ae-3 is 12% (expected ~72%). That's bad. Looks like cache invalidations around 07:25Z.
Marco: That aligns with the rollout. New quantized kernels may change cache keys or eviction behaviour. Which commit hash rolled?
Jen: Rolled commit: a7c3d9f. It includes kernel-selector changes and a small optimizer tweak.
Ravi: Quick hypothesis: kernel-selector now prefers quantized-v2 path that has higher init latency when cache miss. We should confirm selector heuristics and fallback timing.
Carla: I ran kprofile on a repro: heavy time spent in `quant_v2::init_kernel` when cache miss. Single init ~300-500ms, plus streaming overhead.
Marco: Proposal: pin Lynx back to model-gamma-v1.2 on their tenant config and rollback the model-gamma rollout in us-east for now. Also add a hotfix to avoid eager kernel init on request path.
Jen: I've asked support to pin Lynx to v1.2 (they confirmed). Support-bot: Lynx tenant pinned to model-gamma-v1.2 at 2026-03-16T07:42Z.
Ravi: I'll open a small PR to change kernel init to background async + warmup on boot. If we can pre-warm on pod start, p99 should improve.
Marco: Can you also add a temporary routing rule to route high-p99 customers to stable pool? Low effort: route by customer-tier or a whitelist.
Carla: I can instrument a short-lived canary that pre-warms quantized kernels during startup and run bench again.
Jen: Thanks team. Action items:
- Ravi: PR for async kernel init + prewarm (ETA 3h).
- Marco: rollback model-gamma/v1.3 in us-east (or restrict) until prewarm strategy in (ETA 1h).
- Lisa: validate KV cache invalidation cause and whether rollout triggered flush (ETA 2h).
- Carla: confirm prewarm can reduce init latency and share bench results (ETA 2h).
I'll keep Lynx support looped and update when we've got rollback + patch. :thumbsup:
Marco: ping me on the PR, will coordinate rollback once CI passes.
Jen: closing async loop here — will update thread as steps complete.
